Question: Maximum Sum of Non-Adjacent Nodes in a Tree

You are given a tree with N nodes numbered from 1 to N.

Each node has a value.

You must select a subset of nodes such that:

No two selected nodes are directly connected (no parent-child both selected)

The total sum of selected node values is maximized

Print the maximum possible sum.

🔹 Input Format
N
v1 v2 v3 ... vN
N-1 lines of edges (u v)

vi → value of node i

Tree is undirected

🔹 Output Format

Print a single integer —
maximum achievable sum.
